findings: BLOCKER - PH-322 allowed_paths is still incomplete: it adds `pmo_plugins/delivery/models.py` and `delivery/migrations/*`, but not `core/management/commands/verify_integrity.py`. PH-312 spec §9.2 explicitly lists that path in the whitelist expansion (and §9.4 freezes five close/period verifier branches: sequence continuity, AccountingPeriod status/closed_through consistency, closing->closed pairing, ProjectClose/Project.stage consistency, receipt/result references + append-only probes). With the current 16-path list the PH-322 implementation cannot add the required verifier branches (`path_out_of_scope`), and its acceptance `python manage.py verify_integrity --json` cannot cover the frozen invariants. Add the path (and sync the PH-322 spec exact whitelist).

BLOCKER - PH-321 allowed_paths is still incomplete for the UI route: `pmo/settings.py` sets `PMO_PLUGIN_ENTRY_POINT='business_v1'` and `pmo_plugins/delivery/urls.py` owns the central bindings dict (e.g. the contracts route->view map); a new FX-rate page/route requires a binding entry there, but the current 17-path list has no `pmo_plugins/delivery/urls.py`, so the FX page/HTTP tests (`tests/test_v1_fx_http.py`) cannot be wired without path_out_of_scope. Add `pmo_plugins/delivery/urls.py` (contracts/domain_metadata is already allowed for route metadata).

BLOCKER - PH-317 is promoted to ready but its spec still says '仍缺 PH-252（发票实现首片）done，故保持 proposed；PH-252 合入后由下一规划槽复核 DoR 再晋级': the task now has PH-252 done and status ready at BASE 0281043. Update PH-317 spec risk/dependency section to the re-baselined deps (PH-293/252/214/224/232/287 done; PH-150/155 legacy boundaries covered) and the ready decision.

REQUIRED - the PH-321/PH-322 specs' exact whitelists and PH-321 behavior are not synced with the task changes: PH-321 spec lists 14 paths vs task 17 (models.py/migrations/approval_services/change_services absent) and its behavior only authorizes FX snapshot/conversion/read-only display, not the contract-line non-CNY write path that approval/change services implement; PH-322 spec lists 14 vs task 16 (delivery models/migrations absent).
